mapper.select: SELECT 'DEPT'||ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY MIN(t.sort)) AS sort, deptid, deptName,versionid FROM ( SELECT m.deptid, o.orgname AS deptName, d.sort, m.versionid FROM TBL_RISK_MONMODEL m LEFT JOIN TBL_MONMODEL_VERSION v ON v.id=m.versionid LEFT JOIN tbl_organization o ON o.orgid = m.deptid LEFT JOIN TBL_RISK_MONDICTONARY d ON d.id = m.dictonaryid WHERE m.linkorgid = #{orgid} AND V.VERSION=(select max(version) from tbl_monmodel_version where orgid=#{orgid} ) ORDER BY d.sort ) t GROUP BY deptid, deptName,VERSIONID
